name: Chang Sheng Gu
overview:
When He Pan’s close companion, the carp spirit Lin Chun Yu, faces a life-threatening heavenly tribulation, He Pan learns that the only way to save him is to obtain the heart's blood of Rong Chen Zi, the austere and highly respected master of Qingxu Temple.

Determined to save Lin Chun Yu, He Pan deliberately approaches Rong Chen Zi and attempts to seduce him. What begins as a calculated scheme gradually changes.
